title: Tightness of the m2F EKE Bound
summary: The collision bound is tight for the abstract Half-Ideal Cipher model, but its tightness for concrete m2F-based EKE remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: Is the $(q_{\mathrm{IC}})^2/|R|$ term tight for EKE instantiated with m2F, or can the concrete bound be improved?

scope.domain: Concrete security analysis of EKE instantiated with the modified 2-Feistel Half-Ideal Cipher.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine whether the bound is tight for the concrete m2F instantiation, either by constructing an explicit EKE attack or by improving the concrete bound.

citations.label: Randomized Half-Ideal Cipher on Groups with applications to UC (a)PAKE

progress.summary: The source states that the bound is tight when encryption is modeled as an abstract Half-Ideal Cipher. It leaves tightness for the specific modified 2-Feistel instantiation unresolved because no explicit attack is known.
citation_labels: Stanislaw Jarecki et al., Randomized Half-Ideal Cipher on Groups with applications to UC (a)PAKE
